monthEnd.computeCloseBody: Shows the revenue and expense balances for {period} and the net result that rolls into retained earnings. Nothing is posted: the statements carry earnings forward automatically.
monthEnd.computedCloseToast: Close computed: {lines} lines, net result {net}. No journal entry was posted.
monthEnd.lockBody: Locks every transaction dated on or before {date}. A soft lock lets an owner or accountant post with a reason; a hard lock blocks all postings.
monthEnd.overrideChecklist: Lock even though the checklist is incomplete
monthEnd.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
monthEnd.checklistIncomplete: The close checklist is incomplete. Tick the override and give a reason to lock anyway.
monthEnd.unlockBody: Re-opens transactions on or before {date}. The reason is recorded in the audit log. A hard-closed fiscal year can only be reopened by your accounting firm or an administrator.
monthEnd.yearEndBody: Records the fiscal-year close and locks the year. A closing entry to retained earnings is posted only if enabled in close settings; statements are correct either way.
monthEnd.hardClose: Hard close (only the firm or an administrator can reopen)
monthEnd.postClosingEntry: Post a year-end closing entry to retained earnings
